name: DesignModel sources
description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Design's window: DesignWorkspace (pages, the selected page and node, the tool, the open file's URL), the multi-layer selection (DesignSelection: the ordered selected layers with the last as primary, Shift-click toggling, the box around them), DesignNode (the node tree on a page, each node with a fill and text, in absolute page points) and the tree flattened into rows under the expanded set, DesignHistory (the model-owned undo and redo, one named step per edit; New File's step carries the replaced document's file URL, which Undo puts back), the canvas gestures (hit testing, the handles a selection shows, draw, move, resize, nudge, delete, in DesignCanvasEditing and DesignDrawing), the inline text edit (DesignText), where the canvas puts a frame's name, above the frame or inside it at the artboard's top (DesignFrameLabel), the inspector's header lines (DesignInspectorContent), the lock that covers a node's subtree and the line saying why (DesignLocking), the Layers row's eye and lock toggles and the hidden-in-tree check (DesignLayerToggles), the held-id index id minting reads (DesignHeldIDs), aligning the selected layer to its enclosing frame or page with the reason a command is off (DesignAlign), the window toolbar's eight commands with their titles, symbols, identifiers and the reason each can't run (DesignToolbarItems), the file codec (DesignFile), and the use cases a workspace runs on (DesignServices, whose `.live` set is NotBuilt in every slot until each feature lands: each help says the feature isn't built yet and each write refuses; `.fake` is the fixture fakes in Fakes/ that snapshots and fake-mode journeys use), and the workspace actions the window, menus and canvas call (DesignActions: each command's help and run through the services as one named undo step, one-layer delete, nudge and align on today's methods, Zoom to Selection and Select All; DesignActions+Edit: Copy, Cut and Paste, with Paste into the selected frame, Move Layer, and the inspector's style rows as DesignStyleChange, one-layer frame, fill and corner radius on today's methods).
